patch_description: The slope-change count (~20.4) and false reversals (~14.2) have never moved across the 0.72 family. The velocity clamp bounds |Δy| but still permits alternating +limit/−limit steps, which is precisely how residual slope flips survive all downstream damping. This edit adds a guarded zero-phase curvature (second-difference) clamp immediately after the velocity clamp, mirroring its proven slack-doubling retry pattern with a corr ≥ 0.97 guard. It limits |y[k+1] − 2y[k] + y[k−1]| to 1.5× the robust MAD scale of the output's own second differences, applied in forward+backward mirrored sweeps for zero phase. Alternating spurious direction reversals — the direct driver of the slope-change and false-reversal metrics — are flattened while genuine smooth turns (curvature within the robust scale) pass untouched. The 4-attempt slack-doubling guard protects tracking accuracy and lag, so correlation/accuracy metrics should not regress.
